about: The Workbench icons of the MoonChild drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/moonchild.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a small hooded child sitting on a crescent moon in a starry night) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/moonchild.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. MoonChild-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, MoonChild.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's MoonChild.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, LICENSE.txt, README-MoonChild.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
